name: Imprint
description: Restores an imprinted item onto the original. Can't be applied to Fractured Items
directions: Right click this item then left click on the imprinted original item to restore its modifiers. An imprint cannot be dropped or traded to other players.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on the imprinted original item to restore its modifiers. An imprint cannot be dropped or traded to other players.
